method: Manual native UI testing of a copied package through an isolated investigation host; actual packaged controls, MacFileSystem, bundled runtime and UI dispatcher.

manual_observations.invalid_script_save: blocked as expected; rejected source and diagnostics retained; disk ROM and TOML hashes unchanged
manual_observations.native_emulator_selection: failed: user reported mGBA disabled in Browse Finder window, including after checking All Applications; both choosers cancelled
manual_observations.native_emulator_launch_with_isolated_pre: passed: Play started mGBA 0.10.5 and its window URL identified the exact owned Unicode-named ROM
manual_observations.standard_quit_and_restart: not verified: investigation host lacks desktop lifetime; Quit did not exit host; saved disposable host process was terminated after verifying its identity

open_findings: Native application selection is confirmed blocked on this Mac; installed mGBA is valid and direct configured launch succeeds. Exact chooser rejection cause is not established.
Intermittent metadata save denial was not reproduced and remains open; passing saves do not establish its cause or resolution.
limitations: Manual observations are not automated assertion counts; the prior complete suite remains 89 groups / 24,770 assertions.
The isolated host bypasses ordinary desktop startup, IPC and update hooks; its Quit limitation is not a production Quit defect.
No clean no-SDK machine, original app entry-point launch, Applications installation, download quarantine, notarization or privacy-permission flow is certified.
Remembered-emulator behavior across a complete native restart remains unverified; preconfiguration tests only launch.
No product chooser fix was implemented in this investigation.
